errors.problem: The page never returns to j_{f-1}. Its procedure ends with 'one scan refilling holes in order applies $T_0$', and T_0 performs the XORs only at j_0,...,j_{f-2}. So y_{j_{f-1}} <- y_{j_{f-1}} xor x_{j_{f-1}} is never done, and for f=1 (S_0, T_0 identities, B empty) the procedure does nothing at all. The paper finishes by applying the two-bit XOR to x_{j_{f-1}}, y_{j_{f-1}} by the elementary-streams lemma in O(V) time, and notes that for f=1 this step is the entire algorithm.
